# `set_dec_guide_mode`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Select the declination guiding policy: Off, Auto, North or South.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x72c60 (64-bit build); Scope::SetDecGuideMode @0x3dce0 |

Params is a scalar string (or a one-element array holding it), matched case-insensitively against Off, Auto, North and South, which select internal modes 0 to 3 in that order. A success reply is also produced when the telescope object is absent (the handler logs and returns success), so result 0 does not establish that a mode was changed.

Side effects: Changes the declination guide-direction policy and its configuration through the scope object. If the scope object is absent nothing changes and success is still reported.

| `params` | any | no | none (required) | A single string, or an array whose first element is the string. Matching is case-insensitive. No default. Any other string gives 209; a non-string gives 105. [READ] |

## Example

Request, request - Scalar string form (shape READ; example invented):

```json
{"id":1,"method":"set_dec_guide_mode","params":"Auto"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_dec_guide_mode","result":0,"code":0,"id":1}
```

Reply, invalid-mode:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_dec_guide_mode","error":"invalid value","code":209,"id":2}
```
